name: Oath of Redemption
summary: Pacifist knights who believe anyone can be redeemed.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.short: Oath spells that are always prepared for free.
features.summary: You always have your oath spells prepared once you reach the listed paladin levels. They don't count against the number of spells you prepare.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Emissary of Peace
features.short: Bonus action: +5 to Persuasion for 10 minutes.
features.summary: As a bonus action, you gain a +5 bonus to Charisma (Persuasion) checks for 10 minutes.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Rebuke the Violent
features.short: Reaction: an attacker takes the same radiant damage it dealt.
features.summary: Immediately after an attacker within 30 ft. damages another creature, you can use your reaction to make it make a WIS save, taking radiant damage equal to the damage it dealt (half on a success).

features.name: Aura of the Guardian
features.short: Reaction: take damage meant for an ally within 10 ft.
features.summary: When a creature within 10 ft. takes damage, you can use your reaction to take that damage instead (it can't be reduced). The range becomes 30 ft. at 18th level.

features.name: Protective Spirit
features.short: Heal 1d6 + half level each turn while below half HP.
features.summary: At the end of each of your turns, if you are below half your hit points and not incapacitated, you regain 1d6 + half your paladin level hit points.

features.name: Emissary of Redemption
features.short: Resist all damage from creatures; reflect damage back.
features.summary: You have resistance to all damage dealt by other creatures, and whenever a creature damages you, it takes radiant damage equal to half the amount. Both stop working against a creature you attack or affect with a harmful spell, until you rest.

grants.text: Resistance to all damage from creatures (until you attack them); attackers take half the damage as radiant.
